subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 90 to
guide_solution: Summary The passage deals with use of email as a modern mode of communication. It is an electronic system of sending and receiving mails and letters. Letters can be sent and received in an instant with the click of a mouse. It has a huge potential to increase modern business transaction. People are depending hugely on it for their business, educational and administrative purposes. One can use email with the help of a computer, internet connection and commercial mail servers. Email has spread almost all the countries of the world. Even in Bangladesh people has started using mail by commercial way.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Rangpur Cadet College. Sl. No. 06; Page No. 50
